intro: We hold a recorded total fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in India. Use this list of the best MBA colleges under ₹10 lakh only if the card shows the full-time programme you want.
Ranked colleges come first among the top MBA colleges in India 2026. The rest are ordered by recorded fee, lowest first, so a short course or a one-year total can push a famous name into this band.
listLead: Read the programme name before you compare fees. IIM Lucknow, IIFT and IIT Delhi appear near the top because of the fee we currently hold, which is not always the full two-year MBA or PGP cost.
snapshot: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
Thirty-four colleges sit in the ₹5–10 lakh band in our records. The other listings overlap the under-₹5 lakh set, including 147 colleges recorded under ₹1 lakh.
Most colleges here are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes. Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu again have the most listings.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Lucknow's official 2025–27 PGP fee notice lists ₹10.95 lakh in year one and ₹9.80 lakh in year two, or ₹20.75 lakh for the full PGP, so the flagship programme is not on this under-₹10 lakh list.
That official total is above ₹10 lakh, so the flagship PGP is not on this list. IIT Delhi's full-time MBA tuition of ₹12 lakh is also above this cap.

sections.heading: What the 2025–27 fee notices say for the first ranked colleges
paragraphs: IIM Lucknow is 5th, MDI Gurgaon is 9th, IIT Kharagpur is 12th and IIFT is 17th in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking. For IIM Lucknow, the official two-year PGP total is ₹20.75 lakh, which is above this cap.
For IIT Delhi, the DMS admission page lists ₹12 lakh tuition for the two-year MBA. Use those official notices, not the short-course or single-year figures, when you budget for a flagship programme.

compare.heading: How to shortlist the best MBA colleges under ₹10 lakh
paragraphs: A true two-year fee under ₹10 lakh is useful. A second-year total, or a short-course fee, will mislead you if you treat it as the full cost.
bullets: Whether the published fee is for one year or the full programme, and what is excluded (hostel, mess, laptop, refundable deposits).
Whether the card shows a PGP or MBA, an executive diploma, or a management-development course.
The entrance test and the latest category cut-off.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges here have a fee under ₹10 lakh?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in our records have a main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. That count depends on the fee we hold, which can be a single year or a shorter course.

faqs.question: Is IIM Lucknow's PGP really under ₹10 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. The official 2025–27 fee notice lists ₹20.75 lakh for the full two-year PGP, which is above this cap, so IIM Lucknow is not on this list.

faqs.question: What is a typical fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. The median is much lower than the fee at the ranked colleges at the top of the page.

faqs.question: Why does IIT Delhi appear under ₹10 lakh?
faqs.answer: The IIT Delhi DMS admission page lists tuition of ₹12 lakh for the two-year full-time MBA, which is above this cap, so IIT Delhi is not on this budget list.

faqs.question: Are fees under ₹10,000 included?
faqs.answer: No. We treat recorded fees under ₹10,000 as data errors and do not quote them as a minimum. Always confirm the payable fee on the college's official notice.
